long_biography.plain_text:
Dominique Gerardin trained as a merchant-marine officer in France and joined a polar expedition before building a long career as a professional captain. Experience in Mediterranean and other charter markets led him to see an opportunity for locally crewed luxury cruising in Indonesia.

He originated the concept, secured backing from a former client, and became a director and shareholder of South East Asia Exotic Cruise. The business combines ownership with hands-on management rather than functioning as a passive investment. Gerardin remains its managing director, overseeing a high-end charter operation based in Indonesia. He is therefore a founder-operator within that enterprise, without established wider investment holdings, trusts or ownership of the Marseille hotel associated with an accented namesake.
